purpose: Sequences TLS and X.509 PKI migration from RSA/ECDSA to post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM/ML-DSA per NIST FIPS 203/204 Aug 2024). Builds a phased plan (root CAs -> intermediates -> leaf certificates), models payload impact for hybrid/composite/replace strategies, and flags interoperability risks. Reuses CBOM inventory from tool 499.
